question: Estimate the number of HUL stockists / distributors needed for pan-India coverage.
idealClarificationQuestions: Stockists / RS (Redistribution Stockists) — HUL's distributor layer? Yes.
All HUL portfolio (Lifebuoy, Surf Excel, Dove, Lux, Pepsodent, Brooke Bond, Knorr, etc.)? Yes — across portfolio.

expectedLogicalStructure.label: Frame the approach
expectedLogicalStructure.description: Outlets to cover / stockist effective coverage.

expectedLogicalStructure.label: Calculate
expectedLogicalStructure.description: Total Indian retail outlets HUL targets: ~90 lakh (kiranas + modern trade + chemists + cosmetic stores).

expectedLogicalStructure.label: Calculate
expectedLogicalStructure.description: Plus rural distributors via Project Shakti (woman entrepreneurs): ~1.5 lakh shakti ammas in rural villages.

benchmarkAssumptions.parameter: Total Indian retail outlets HUL targets
benchmarkAssumptions.value: ~90 lakh (kiranas + modern trade + chemists + cosmetic stores).

benchmarkAssumptions.parameter: Plus sub-stockists in remote / Tier 4 areas
Plus rural distributors via Project Shakti (woman entrepreneurs)
benchmarkAssumptions.value: ~1.5 lakh shakti ammas in rural villages.

calculationFlow: Total Indian retail outlets HUL targets: ~90 lakh (kiranas + modern trade + chemists + cosmetic stores).
Plus rural distributors via Project Shakti (woman entrepreneurs): ~1.5 lakh shakti ammas in rural villages.
Total formal distribution network: ~14,000-15,000 stockists + 1.5 lakh shakti partners.
